title: Record one odd-heavy n=8 parity prefix at 3/2 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

For the `n = 8` symbol `(1, 3/8, 1/8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)`, every proper prefix has infinity norm at most `3/2`. The largest is `3/2`. The right shear alone is `731/512`. This is the odd-heavy step left open by #4702. The branch is from fetched main and does not replay that unmerged package.

The tail `l1` is `1/2`. The schedule applies the right shear, then the even child, then the Schur child, then the left shear, and repeats that order inside every child. There are 22 factors and 21 proper prefixes. The quotient is `(3/8, -3/64, 3/512, -3/4096)`. The first prefix's bottom row sums to `1 + 3/8 + 3/64 + 3/512 = 731/512`. The next nontrivial factor is the even child's right shear. From there, the other 20 proper prefixes have infinity norm `3/2`. The product of the 22 factors equals the even/odd reordering of the Toeplitz matrix.

`731/512 < 3/2 < 9/4`. Moving mass from the even coefficient onto the odd coefficient raises the first shear from the equal-quarters value `85/64` to `731/512` and still leaves it under the one-level cap. Eight nontrivial factors sit in the proper prefixes. The even child is `(1, 1/8, 0, 0)`. The Schur child is `(1, -1/64, 9/512, -9/4096)`.

This is one symbol. It does not bound every tail of `l1` at most `1/2`, the generator-shear compiler, the completed Gaussian stage, or the dyadic `p^100` normalizer. No new κ. The selected record is `60403/20000000`.

- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Upstream fetches at 2026-10-22T16:50:09Z, 2026-10-22T16:52:53Z, and the pre-submit fetch at 2026-10-22T16:53:06Z were that commit. The pinned blobs of `certificates/selected-result.json` (`c35482cd9035843b15a634cc8276a7e1e40e8395`), `GAUSSIAN.md` (`adfb28c93e6b06178c901caaac39ede41a9e541b`), and `vendor/SHALLOW-TOEPLITZ.md` (`bc4349b2daea548ffa09e1f38a31f1df86b0b7be`) were unchanged. κ remains `60403/20000000`.
